text: つり　バカ　ポケモン　バカに　であう！
note: つりバカ ("fishing nut") echoes Tsuribaka Nisshi (釣りバカ日誌), a very well-known Japanese manga and film series about a fishing-obsessed office worker.
claim: Tsuribaka Nisshi (釣りバカ日誌) is a long-running Japanese manga and film series about a salaryman obsessed with fishing.

check.quote: Tsuribaka Nisshi (釣りバカ日誌; "Fishing Nut's Diary") is a Japanese fishing-themed manga series written by Jūzō Yamasaki and illustrated by Kenichi Kitami. It has been serialized in Shogakukan's seinen manga magazine Big Comic Original since 1979.
